comments.body: Daemon and plugin half landed (a12fd67): AgentFacts.waiting, Report.waiting / report --waiting, cleared at the agent's next turn, finished_unseen held off while set, a SessionStart line only in Muster panes, daemon.agent.turn_ended logged with waiting true/false to measure adoption. Review: a waiting fact whose work finishes inside the same turn, or never wakes the agent, sticks until the next turn. The sidebar half waits for the cut-over.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Unverified risk (slot 2, round 9): if Claude Code fires PostToolUse for a background sub-agent's tools after the main turn's Stop, the first such call counts as a new turn and clears a wait just declared. daemon.agent.turn_ended in the run log will show it.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
amterp (2026-09-27): two workers read idle in the sidebar while each waited on a gate it had started in the background. An agent in that state is doing what it should, and Muster should say so.

A background-task count cannot tell this apart from an agent that left a dev server running and is finished: both show '1 shell still running' in Claude Code, which treats them the same. Only the agent knows whether it is waiting, so the agent says so (decided with amterp):
- When an agent ends its turn to wait on something it started, it runs "$MUSTER_DAEMON" report with a short waiting fact (for example 'waiting on: full gate'). Report already carries free-form facts that the daemon stores and publishes per pane.
- The hook that fires when a turn starts (UserPromptSubmit, and whatever else starts a turn) clears it, so a stale 'waiting' cannot outlive the wait.
- The instruction reaches only Muster panes: a SessionStart hook adds it when $MUSTER_PANE is set, in the same plugin as the state hooks (a_2XarofkTD). Keep it to one short trigger and one line: amterp's concern is added load on the model, and an agent that forgets reads as done, which is today's behavior, so forgetting is harmless.
- The sidebar shows an idle row with that fact as waiting, with its text, distinct from idle (a_2XQXk8sou). done (finished_unseen, a_2XYi76eVz) holds off while it is set: an agent that declared it is waiting has not finished.
- Worth recording in the report: how often agents actually declare it in practice.
title: An agent can say it is waiting on its own work, so it does not read idle
